title: Pyke Boss
description: The boss of the Pyke Syndicate was pragmatic and did what he could to ensure the spice flow on Tatooine. When deadly situations cropped up, he would do his best to smooth them over, but even that would cost him his life when he picked the wrong side of the conflict against Boba Fett and the assassin Fennec Shand. He died horribly by Fennec's hand.
